messages:
nina: FYI PR #4732 is failing docs CI. The optimize toolkit page has an outdated Python snippet and a broken internal link. Blocking a small customer migration.
omar: I'll take the snippet. Which params are wrong?
nina: It uses `batch_size` and `quant_type: q4_0`. Runtime now prefers `batching.window_ms` + `batching.max_inflight` and profile names like `q_standard_q4_1`. Also the embed example points to /docs/old/kv-cache.md which 404s.
lee: Quick patch assembled. Python snippet updated below, plus a one-line migration note.
lee: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="...")
resp = client.generate(
  model="redwood/fast-13b-q_standard_q4_1",
  input="Describe eventual consistency in two sentences.",
  optimize={"batching": {"window_ms": 50, "max_inflight": 4}, "cache": {"kv_ttl_secs": 600, "prefix_kv": True}, "quant_profile": "q_standard_q4_1"}
)
print(resp.text)
```
odocs-bot: [automated] Linkcheck: 1 broken link found in PR 4732 -> optimize/embedding.md line 20.
omar: I'll add redirect from /docs/old/kv-cache.md -> /optimize/batching-and-cache.md and a short migration blurb: "q4_0 -> q4_1: expect memory savings; run smoke eval, fallback to fp16 if needed."
nina: CI green locally?
omar: yes, mkdocs build + linkcheck passed. Pushed branch `docs/4732-quickfix`.
docs-bot: Build: success. Linkcheck: success.
nina: Thanks all 44d Merging and will notify support to unblock the customer.
